tags.name: Auditable Item Graph
tags.description: Endpoints which are modelled to access an auditable item graph contract.

requestBody.description: Create an auditable item graph vertex.

201.description: The rest request ended in created response.

400.description: The server cannot process the request, see the content for more details.

401.description: You are not authorized to use the API or no credentials were supplied, see the content for more details.

get.summary: Query graph vertices by id or alias

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id or alias to try and find.

parameters.name: idMode
parameters.description: Which field to look in with the id, defaults to both.

parameters.name: idExact
parameters.description: Find only exact matches, default to false meaning partial matching.

parameters.name: resourceTypes
parameters.description: Include vertices with specific resource types, comma separated.

parameters.name: conditions
parameters.description: The conditions to filter the streams, JSON stringified `EntityCondition<IAuditableItemGraphVertex>`.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: The order for the results, default to dateCreated.

parameters.name: orderByDirection
parameters.description: The direction for the order, defaults to desc.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: The properties to return as a comma separated list, defaults to "id,dateCreated,aliases,annotationObject".

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The optional cursor to get next chunk.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit the number of entities to return.

200.description: The response to getting the a list of the vertices with matching ids or aliases.

AuditableItemGraphCreateRequest.description: The data to be used in the vertex.

dateCreated.description: The date/time of when the element was created.

dateModified.description: The date/time of when the element was modified.

dateDeleted.description: The date/time of when the element was deleted, as we never actually remove items.

organizationIdentity.description: The identity of the organization which controls the vertex.

aliases.description: Alternative aliases that can be used to identify the vertex.

resources.description: The resources attached to the vertex.

verified.description:
Is the vertex verified, will only be populated when verification is requested.
Always undefined when the vertex is in bypass mode.

version.description:
The version of the vertex, populated only when getting a specific version.
Always undefined when the vertex is in bypass mode.
Maps to https://schema.org/version.

AuditableItemGraphUpdatePartialRequest.description:
